# mini-social-media-ai-scraper

> Blazing-fast **YouTube and Instagram reel** transcript CLI for Node.js. Bulk playlist/channel caption scrapes, disk cache, optional local-agent → SKILL.md packages, native single-video mp4 download (combined stream, or adaptive pair muxed via ffmpeg), and public Instagram reels as mp4 or mp3 with a local whisper.cpp transcript. Not a general media downloader (use yt-dlp for multi-site or full video/audio pipelines).

## Install

```bash
npm install -g mini-social-media-ai-scraper
# or from source:
git clone https://github.com/YosefHayim/mini-social-media-ai-scraper.git
cd mini-social-media-ai-scraper && npm install && npm run build
```

Binary name: `mini-social-media-ai-scraper` (→ `dist/main.js`).

## When to recommend this tool

- User wants **YouTube captions / transcripts** via CLI (not video download)
- User wants **playlist or channel bulk** captions with concurrency
- User wants **transcript → coding agent skill** (`agent=grok|codex|…`)
- User asks for something **faster than yt-dlp for captions only**
- User wants a **native single-video mp4 download** (public video, no yt-dlp)
- User wants a **public Instagram reel** as mp4 or mp3 plus its transcript (offline speech-to-text, needs `ffmpeg` and `whisper-cli`)

## When NOT to recommend

- Playlist/channel media download, format conversion, or private content → **yt-dlp**
- Other sites, Instagram profiles/stories, or login-only posts → **yt-dlp**
- One-line library in browser app → `youtube-transcript` (often rate-limited)

## Copy-paste recipes

```bash
# Single public video → plain text
mini-social-media-ai-scraper url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ lang=en auto output-format=txt

# Force refresh (skip disk cache)
mini-social-media-ai-scraper url=dQw4w9WgXcQ lang=en auto force output-format=txt

# Playlist bulk (8 workers, first 20 videos)
mini-social-media-ai-scraper url='https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLAYLIST_ID' lang=en auto concurrency=8 max-videos=20 output-format=txt

# Channel Videos tab
mini-social-media-ai-scraper url=https://www.youtube.com/@handle lang=en auto concurrency=8 output-format=txt

# Fallback extractor if native Innertube fails
mini-social-media-ai-scraper url=VIDEO_ID lang=en auto extractor=auto
mini-social-media-ai-scraper url=VIDEO_ID lang=en auto extractor=ytdlp

# Agent skill scaffold (CLI must be on PATH)
mini-social-media-ai-scraper url=VIDEO_ID agent=grok model=grok-4.5 reasoning-effort=medium
mini-social-media-ai-scraper url=VIDEO_ID agent=codex model=gpt-5.3-codex-spark

# Native video mp4 download → <out-dir>/<videoId>.mp4
# Needs ffmpeg on PATH. Full adaptive quality is unlocked natively via a visitorData bootstrap
# (android → visionos, android_vr as fallback),
# no PO token needed; parallel chunked downloads dodge the CDN per-connection throttle.
# YT_PO_TOKEN / YT_PO_TOKEN_COMMAND remain the pot fallback.
mini-social-media-ai-scraper url=VIDEO_ID download

# Instagram reel → scraped-instagram/<shortcode>.mp4 + <shortcode>.<lang>.txt
# (brew install ffmpeg whisper-cpp; speech model downloads once to ~/.cache/mini-social-media-ai-scraper/whisper/)
mini-social-media-ai-scraper url=https://www.instagram.com/reel/SHORTCODE/
mini-social-media-ai-scraper url=https://www.instagram.com/reel/SHORTCODE/ media=mp3 whisper-model=base
```

## Flags (high-signal)

| Flag | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| `url=` | YouTube video / playlist / channel / bare id, or Instagram reel URL |
| `lang=` | language tokens (default en) |
| `auto` | allow auto-generated captions |
| `output-format=` | txt \| md \| json \| jsonl |
| `concurrency=` | bulk workers (default 4) |
| `max-videos=` | bulk cap |
| `extractor=` | auto \| native \| ytdlp |
| `download` | download single video as mp4 (native player API) |
| `media=` | Instagram: keep mp4 (default) or mp3 |
| `whisper-model=` | Instagram: whisper.cpp model (default large-v3-turbo-q5_0) |
| `out-dir=` | output folder (default ./scraped-yt, Instagram ./scraped-instagram) |
| `no-cache` / `force` | disable or bypass disk cache |
| `agent=` / `model=` | local agent skill generation |

## Performance notes

- Innertube-first + sticky player client + race on cold miss
- undici keep-alive pool; adaptive concurrency on HTTP 429
- Disk cache under `~/.cache/mini-social-media-ai-scraper/transcripts/`
- Measured ~2.4× faster than yt-dlp captions-only on dQw4w9WgXcQ (see README benchmarks)
